rows.name: Star (pentagram)
rows.meaning: the khātam / star of Solomon — sovereignty, the whole under one sign

rows.name: Three staffs
rows.meaning: the three rods — often read for the threefold Name and increase

rows.name: The ladder
rows.meaning: ascent and descent of power; force disciplined into rungs

rows.name: The ring
rows.meaning: the sealing ring of Solomon — binding and command of spirits

rows.name: The hook (wāw)
rows.meaning: the drawing-in of grace and provision

rows.name: The tailed mīm
rows.meaning: union and attraction; love and concord

rows.name: The chain
rows.meaning: binding, limit, and the closing of the seal
